goal: Documentation accuracy review: docs that match the code they describe.
use: Documentation accuracy review: docs that match the code they describe. Use when docs or examples are changed or the code they describe changed.

steps.note: List the docs. Find the README, guides and examples that mention the changed code.
Run examples. Check each example still compiles or runs as written.
Compare. Flag names, options and steps that no longer match the code.
Check links. Flag references to moved or deleted files.
Report. Each mismatch with file and line, and the correction.
